title: How Localizing Return of the Obra Dinn Nearly Sunk the Game | War Stories | Ars Technica
summary: Lucas Pope, creator of Return of the Obra Dinn, explains in Ars Technica's War Stories how localizing the game's logbook nearly sank the project.
why: Recommended for its insight into game design and cited as a vivid example of how tricky localization can be.
